reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Access, infrastructure and skills for developing countries
themes.definition: Calls for international cooperation giving developing countries/LDCs access to AI technology, knowledge, infrastructure, financing, digital literacy and talent.
themes.inclusion: Passages requesting technology access, financing, digital infrastructure, literacy or research capacity for AI in developing countries or LDCs.
themes.exclusion: Statements only about unequal access without concrete support measures (use AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE).
themes.boundary_cases: Equitable access framed through the Global Digital Compact takes AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE and AI_UN_ROLE instead.

examples.quote: calls for international cooperation that enables developing countries to access the technology, knowledge, infrastructure, and financing they need
It is also imperative to advance AI and digital capabilities in LDCs while concurrently safeguarding cybersecurity.

themes.label: Rights-centred responsible AI governance
themes.definition: Advocacy of responsible AI governance centred on human dignity, transparency and fundamental rights.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for AI governance centred on dignity, transparency or rights.
themes.exclusion: Governance calls with no rights/ethics content (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: Rights-based governance calls combined with international cooperation may also take AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: We advocate responsible technology governance centered on human dignity, transparency, and fundamental rights.

themes.label: International regulation of AI use
themes.definition: Calls for international cooperation to establish comprehensive regulations for AI use and development.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging international rules or regulations governing AI.
themes.exclusion: National AI policy frameworks alone (use AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: A passage listing both domestic policy frameworks and international regulation takes this code for the latter.

examples.quote: international cooperation remains essential to establish comprehensive regulations governing the use and development of AI

themes.label: Equitable access via Global Digital Compact
themes.definition: Emphasis on equitable access to digital technologies and AI, often referencing the Global Digital Compact.
themes.inclusion: Passages stressing equitable access to AI or recognising the Compact for that purpose.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief endorsement of the Compact for equitable AI access also takes AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: the Global Compact for Digitalization for equitable access to digital technologies and artificial intelligence

value.rationale: Passages from small developing states (Sao Tome, Cape Verde, Timor-Leste) frame AI through inclusion: access, capacity and financing for developing countries, rights-centred governance and international regulation, with Cape Verde offering only a brief equitable-access reference.
